title: Pendulum numbers tied to geometry
prerequisite: Learner can read degrees and identify a pivot and string length.
success_check: Learner predicts the readout before each swing, then compares the displayed angle to the drawn angle.

scenes.title: Pendulum numbers tied to geometry
scenes.concept_target: The displayed theta equals the drawn swing angle because both derive from the same state.

narration_cues.text: Watch the pivot. The string of length L swings out. The theta readout shows the same angle in degrees as the drawn swing. Predict the readout, then compare.
narration_cues.change: The bob swings out to 30 degrees while the readout tracks the same theta.

narration_cues.text: Now it swings back past center. The theta readout follows the string in degrees. Check that the displayed angle equals the drawn angle.
narration_cues.change: The bob swings back to minus 30 degrees while the readout tracks the same theta.
